messages:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — I'm seeing a cluster of stale trial accounts that are keeping our account health distribution artificially high. Proposing a lightweight CRM admin rule: auto-archive trials with last_active > 90d and set a temporary health_score override to avoid skewing renewal signals. Thoughts?

Samir Patel: Do we have counts and how this moves tiering? Can you paste the query you used?

Maya Chen: Pulled a quick slice — looks like ~1.2k trials with no activity in 90+ days. Example query I used:

```sql
SELECT account_id, last_active_at, health_score, renewal_risk
FROM accounts
WHERE account_type = 'trial'
  AND last_active_at < now() - interval '90 days'
  AND status != 'archived';
```

Priya Rao: Agree with auto-archive for noisy trials. A couple notes:
- We should not overwrite historical health_score permanently (keep original in a meta field).
- Gate the automation so it doesn't archive accounts with active renewal opportunities or recent enablement tasks.

Priya Rao: Draft playbook automation snippet (webhook-based) we can test in staging:

```yaml
trigger: cron: daily
filter:
  - account_type: trial
  - last_active_days: "">=90""
  - renewal_risk: [low, medium]  # skip high-risk renewals
actions:
  - webhook: https://cs-playbooks.internal/reconcile/archive
    payload:
      account_id: {account_id}
      preserve_health_score: true
      note: "auto-archived-by-csops-90d-stale"

Liam O'Neill: +1 but want to flag reporting impacts. If we set health_score override to -10, our quarterly LTV cohorts will change. Can we instead add a temporary tag like `stale_trial` and exclude tagged accounts in the renewal model dataset pipelines?

Maya Chen: Good point. I like the tag approach better. We can run the archiver to set `archived = true` and `tags += ['stale_trial:2026-03']` and leave health_score unchanged in the audit record, but mark the active health_score field as `null` for operational dashboards.

Samir Patel: For safety, can we do a staged rollout? 1) dry-run with logs only 2) automated tagging (no archive) 3) archive small batch (5%) 4) full run. I'll own rollout plan.

cs-bot: playbook-runner scheduled: staging-dryrun for crm-stale-trial-archiver at 2026-03-22T03:00:00Z — job id rb-8921

Priya Rao: I'll add a quick eval to the healthscore monitor to assert rolling 7d change < 2% after each phase. If we see >2% drift, rollback.

Liam O'Neill: Also add a BI-safe-list for any accounts with active renewals/opps > $10k per quarter. Don't want to accidentally archive pipeline.

Maya Chen: Action items:
- Samir: rollout plan + 5% batch run (ETA Friday)
- Priya: healthscore regression check config (ETA Wednesday)
- Liam: BI safe-list criteria + query (ETA Thursday)
- I'll open a small PR for the playbook webhook and a staging dry-run.

Samir Patel: Sounds good. tagging-first approach minimizes reporting churn. I'll post the rollout checklist here once ready. :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: Thanks team — will follow up with links to the staging logs and the PR.

cs-bot: reminder: please add post-run notes to the playbook run rb-8921.
